scripts.rust:test: cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/arch/deps.mjs
scripts.rust:test:desktop: cargo test -p kentos-ui -p kentos-ui-showcase -p kentos-desktop && cargo clippy -p kentos-ui -p kentos-ui-showcase -p kentos-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:wasm: cargo build -p kentos-geometry-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir apps/web/src/wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/kentos_geometry_wasm.wasm
scripts.rust:wasm:formats: cargo build -p kentos-formats-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir apps/web/src/io/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/kentos_formats_wasm.wasm
scripts.rust:wasm:svg: cargo build -p kentos-svg-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir apps/web/src/style/svg/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/kentos_svg_wasm.wasm
scripts.test:rust: pnpm rust:test && pnpm wasm && pnpm -C apps/web exec vitest run src/wasm src/io
scripts.db:setup: cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- db-setup && cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- migrate && cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- dev-seed
